findings.one_line: The reproduced compact-support argument does not establish the cited finite-graph reduction: positivity on connected relative interiors of individual fibers does not supply the global/product-support intersection and conditional-factorization hypotheses used by the restricted-ANM proof; the claimed extension needs a proved bridge or a restriction to the cited theorem's domain.
At y=h(x) with a uniform root, L_xy/L_xx=-1/h'(x), so its x-derivative is h''(x)/h'(x)^2=2/(1+2x)^2, not 2h''(x)/h'(x)^2=4/(1+2x)^2; the nonzero-obstruction conclusion survives after correction.

The singleton claim conditions on Q_all(B), where B is the realized random band collection, without a quantifier making this a property of P or an event controlled on E_n; state separation uniformly for every band realization compatible with E_n (or give an equivalent deterministic query set) before asserting the probability guarantee.

cited_checks.note: The supplied verbatim Definition 27 and Theorem 28 state identifiability of a causally minimal restricted additive-noise model from its joint law; this matches the cited node's substrate claim.
